stages.label: Formation
stages.summary: Establish the project, its ideals, consent process, and public home.

stages.label: Recording
stages.summary: Volunteers sign consent and record the shared Santa script.

stages.label: Dataset
stages.summary: Review, quality-check, and publish consented recordings as an open dataset.

stages.label: Training
stages.summary: Train a high-quality blended classic American Santa voice.

stages.label: Release
stages.summary: Release the free, open Santa voice for anyone to use.
